comment: Cases for scripts/memory-eval.mjs (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-memory-redesign-design.md, §10). `notes`: a notebook to test with. `neutral`: questions that have nothing to do with any note (no slip may come: the rate of over-reference). `recall`: questions that clearly bear on one note (the slip must bring it: the rate of hits). `writes`: what a model might ask to be written, with the messages of the person, and what the check must say. `conversations`: scripted conversations for the live run (what a model should write and should not).
